description: Your issue desk (was mzizi_report_issue): report a problem with a component or the registry. It goes to your own desk, which reproduces it via fundi, drafts an issue body with what the reproduction returned and logs it to fundi; fundi files the GitHub issue and tracks it, so action 'get' shows where yours got to. 'list' shows your reports, 'retry' re-attempts one that drafted but could not be logged. Needs sign-in: the desk belongs to your Mzizi console user; without it, the answer carries the report as a pre-filled GitHub issue for mzizi-dev/mzizi-registry, so it is never lost, and over HTTP the server answers with an OAuth challenge so your client can offer sign-in. With target 'docs', it instead reports a problem with a documentation page on docs.mzizi.dev (give `path` and `message`); that needs no account.

action.description: What to do. Defaults to filing a new report.

path.description: For target 'docs': the page's URL path, without .mdx, e.g. /toolchain/cli.

reportId.description: Report id. Required for actions 'get' and 'retry'.

skill.description: fundi skill to run for the reproduction. fundi never infers a skill from text, so omit this to let the report kind choose one.

target.description: Where it goes: 'issue-desk' (default; sign-in) or 'docs' (a docs.mzizi.dev page; free).

name: mzizi_feedback
title: Report an issue or give feedback
